# Set up environment
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(Matrix)

theme_set(theme_classic()) 
source("https://github.com/jjcurtin/lab_support/blob/main/format_path.R?raw=true")

path_data <- format_path("llmpanel/data_processed")
path_chtc <- format_path(str_c("llmpanel/chtc/train_", params$version))
```

## Best config 
```{r}
folds <- read_csv(here::here(path_chtc, "output", 
                             str_c("batch_results_", params$version, ".csv")), 
                  show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  arrange(config_num, outer_split_num, inner_split_num) |> 
  glimpse()

folds |>
  summarise(rsq = mean(rsq),
            mae = mean(mae),
            n = n(),
            .by = c(feature_set, hp1, hp2, hp3)) |>
  arrange(desc(rsq)) |>
  print(n = 100)

best <- folds |>
  summarise(rsq = mean(rsq),
            mae = mean(mae),
            n = n(),
            .by = c(feature_set, hp1, hp2, hp3)) |> 
  arrange(desc(rsq)) |> 
  filter(hp1 <= .1) |> 
  slice_head(n = 1)

best$algorithm <- "glmnet"

best
```

## Feature set comparison (education coding)

Best configuration within each feature set. The first table uses the same
`hp1 <= .1` restriction as the overall best config above; the second table
removes it.
```{r}
#| label: feature-set-best

config_by_fs <- folds |>
  summarise(rsq = mean(rsq),
            mae = mean(mae),
            n = n(),
            .by = c(feature_set, hp1, hp2, hp3)) |>
  filter(hp1 <= .1) |>
  slice_max(rsq, n = 1, by = feature_set, with_ties = FALSE)

config_by_fs

# no restriction on alpha
folds |>
  summarise(rsq = mean(rsq),
            mae = mean(mae),
            n = n(),
            .by = c(feature_set, hp1, hp2, hp3)) |>
  slice_max(rsq, n = 1, by = feature_set, with_ties = FALSE)
```

Paired differences across the validation folds, with each feature set at its
own best config. These folds overlap in their training data and share
participants, so the spread is descriptive and not a formal test.
```{r}
#| label: feature-set-paired

folds_fs <- folds |>
  inner_join(config_by_fs |> select(feature_set, hp1, hp2),
             by = c("feature_set", "hp1", "hp2")) |>
  select(feature_set, outer_split_num, inner_split_num, rsq, mae) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = feature_set, values_from = c(rsq, mae)) |>
  mutate(diff_rsq = rsq_edu_ordinal - rsq_edu_collapsed,
         diff_mae = mae_edu_ordinal - mae_edu_collapsed)

# diff_rsq > 0 and diff_mae < 0 both favor edu_ordinal
folds_fs |>
  summarise(n_folds = sum(!is.na(diff_rsq)),
            mean_diff_rsq = mean(diff_rsq, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_diff_rsq = sd(diff_rsq, na.rm = TRUE),
            prop_folds_ordinal_better = mean(diff_rsq > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_diff_mae = mean(diff_mae, na.rm = TRUE))
```

Fit model to full dataset
```{r}
source(here::here(path_chtc, "input", "training_controls.R"))
d <- read_csv(here::here(path_chtc, "input", "data_trn.csv"),
              show_col_types = FALSE)

# No glimpse() of the raw data here on purpose. The raw file includes IP
# addresses, GPS coordinates, addresses and free text, and this report embeds
# everything it prints.
cat("Raw data:", nrow(d), "rows,", ncol(d), "columns\n")

d <- format_data(d)
rec <- build_recipe(d = d, config = best)
rec_prep <- rec |> 
  prep(training = d)
feat <- rec_prep |> 
  bake(new_data = NULL)

model <- linear_reg(mixture = best$hp1,
                    penalty = best$hp2) |>
      set_engine("glmnet") |>
      set_mode("regression") |>
      fit(y ~ ., data = feat)

# model <- boost_tree(learn_rate = best$hp1,
#                         tree_depth = best$hp2,
#                         mtry = best$hp3,
#                         trees = 500,  # set high but use early stopping
#                         stop_iter = 20) |>  
#       set_engine("xgboost",
#                  validation = 0.2) |>  
#       set_mode("regression") |> 
#       fit(y ~ ., data = feat)

model |> write_rds(here::here(path_data, 
                              str_c("model_pref_", params$version, ".rds")))
```


```{r}
model |>
  tidy() |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate))) |> 
  print(n = Inf)
```

Model coefficients  
```{r}
model |>
  tidy() |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)", estimate != 0) |>
  slice_max(abs(estimate), n = 30) |>
  mutate(term = reorder(term, estimate)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
  labs(x = "Coefficient", y = NULL)
```

```{r}
tidy(model) |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
  filter(estimate != 0) |>
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(estimate > 0, "positive", "negative"),
    abs_estimate = abs(estimate),
    feature_type = if_else(str_detect(term, "_x_"), 
                           "Interaction", 
                           "Main Effect")) |>
  filter(feature_type == "Interaction") |> 
  slice_max(abs_estimate, n = 30, by = feature_type) |>
  arrange(feature_type, abs_estimate) |>
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = term)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = abs_estimate, y = term, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("positive" = "forestgreen", "negative" = "firebrick"),
    name = "Direction"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ feature_type, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Absolute Coefficient",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Feature Importance"
  )
```
